features.evidence: pkg/tool/builtin/calc.go + clock.go + tests (13 subtests)

features.name: Tool Calling Integration
features.description: Wire tool schemas into LLM request, parse tool_calls from response, execute and return results. Single-step only (no loop yet).
features.evidence: pkg/tool/executor.go + cmd/goforge/main.go -tools mode; fix openai ToolMessage(content, toolCallID) arg order

features.name: ToolSet Interface
features.description: Define the ToolSet interface for dynamic, runtime-discovered tool collections (deferred from M2-001). ToolSet exposes Tools(ctx) []Tool; the Registry consumes a ToolSet to register its tools, so dynamic and static tools share one execution path. Foundational Ring 2 capability — scheduled NEXT, before M5.
features.evidence: pkg/tool/toolset.go — ToolSet interface (Tools(ctx)([]Tool,error)) + Registry.RegisterSet; toolset_test.go (fake set, resolve-error passthrough, duplicate-name).

features.name: MCP Client (ToolSet impl)
features.description: MCP CLIENT: consume external MCP servers and adapt their tools into our Tool interface (an implementation of the M2-006 ToolSet — exactly how Eino/tRPC/ADK do it). Dynamic discovery via ListTools, execution via CallTool; transports stdio + streamable HTTP. SDK: official modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk (pure Go, satisfies no-CGO/single-binary; ADK uses it). This is FOUNDATIONAL — it lets GoForge agents reuse the whole MCP tool ecosystem (filesystem, git, etc.) — and is wired BEFORE M5. (MCP server side is M7-005, deprioritized.)
features.evidence: pkg/tool/mcpclient/ (SDK isolated here): client.go (Connect, cursor-paginated Tools, Close, stdio+streamable-HTTP transports, narrow session iface for tests) + tool.go (mcpTool adapter: InputSchema→json.RawMessage params, Arguments passthrough, TextContent extraction, IsError→error). Tests: fake-session unit + real-SDK in-memory-transport integration, -race. Wired into CLI via -mcp-servers / GOFORGE_MCP_SERVERS (connect → RegisterSet → Close on exit). dep: modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.6.1 (CGO_ENABLED=0 build verified).

milestones.name: ReAct Agent
milestones.ai_skills: ReAct pattern, step limit, parallel tool execution

features.name: Event Types
features.description: Define Event sum type: ThinkEvent, ToolCallEvent, ToolResultEvent, FinalResponseEvent, ErrorEvent.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/event.go — enum EventType + tagged Event struct (reuses Ring 1 ToolCall/ToolResult/Usage) + 5 constructors + String(); event_test.go (table-driven, 11 subtests)

features.name: ReAct Loop
features.description: Core ~200-line ReAct loop: while(tool_calls) { call LLM → execute tools → append results }. max_steps guard. Returns iter.Seq2[Event, error].
features.evidence: pkg/agent/agent.go SimpleAgent.Run — iter.Seq2 yield loop, maxSteps guard (default 10), ErrMaxStepsExceeded, early-break handling; agent_test.go via scripted mockLLM

features.name: Parallel Tool Execution
features.description: When LLM returns multiple tool_calls, execute them concurrently via goroutine + errgroup. Timeout per tool.
features.evidence: pkg/tool/executor.go ExecuteParallel — errgroup, order-preserving results, per-tool context timeout, one failure doesn't cancel others; golang.org/x/sync promoted to direct dep; executor_test.go (order/failure-isolation/timeout, -race clean)

features.name: Agent Interface
features.description: Define Agent interface with Run(ctx, task) iter.Seq2[Event, error]. Implement SimpleAgent wrapping ReAct loop.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/agent.go — Agent interface (boundary) + SimpleAgent concrete impl + functional Options (WithSystemPrompt/WithModel/WithMaxSteps/WithToolTimeout) + compile-time assertion; wired into CLI -agent mode (cmd/goforge/main.go runAgentMode/handleAgentChat)

features.name: Built-in Tools: File + Shell
features.description: File read/write/list and shell exec tools with basic sandboxing (allowed dirs, command allowlist).
features.evidence: pkg/tool/builtin/sandbox.go (resolvePath: filepath.Rel containment + EvalSymlinks anti-escape; command allowlist), file.go (read_file/write_file/list_files), shell.go (exec_command, no-shell exec + per-call timeout + output cap). Wired into CLI: file tools always on (rooted at -workdir/cwd), exec_command opt-in via -allow-commands. Tests cover traversal/symlink-escape/allowlist/timeout under -race

milestones.name: Context Engineering
milestones.goal: Three-tier context compaction + stage-aware context loading
milestones.ai_skills: Token counting, compaction strategies, context window management

features.name: Token Counter
features.description: Token counting utility (tiktoken-go or simple word-based estimator). Counts messages, tool results, system prompts.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/token.go — TokenCounter interface + Estimator with configurable RunesPerToken (default 4; CJK ~2, required for Chinese content); tiktoken avoided (CGO/BPE vs no-CGO). Runtime budget uses real llm.Usage, estimator is fallback. token_test.go

features.name: ContextPolicy
features.description: Define ContextPolicy struct: MaxTokens, Sources ([]ContextSource func type — the pluggable seam for retrieval-augmented context incl. future long-term memory / vector retrieval, see M8), Breadth, Depth, RetainRecent, Compact (CompactFunc), Counter. Agents configured via WithContextPolicy.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/context.go — ContextPolicy + Breadth/Depth enums + ContextSource/CompactFunc func types; zero value disables (preserves baseline). context_test.go

features.name: Three-Tier Compaction
features.description: Budget check (drop oldest tool results) → micro-compact (truncate long outputs) → full compaction (LLM-based summarization). Inspired by Claude Code.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/context.go DefaultCompact — middle-out, round-atomic (never orphans tool_call/result, which OpenAI/Anthropic reject); preserves system + first user + RetainRecent tail; best-effort termination. Tests assert no-orphan-pairing + live validation in agent loop

features.name: System Prompt Engineering
features.description: Configurable system prompt builder: role definition + stage instructions + tool descriptions + context policy directives.
features.evidence: pkg/agent/prompt.go BuildSystemPrompt(role, tools, policy) — role + sorted tool list + breadth/depth strategy hint; pure & deterministic (cache-friendly). prompt_test.go

features.name: ContextSource Seam
features.description: Wire ContextPolicy.Sources into SimpleAgent.Run (load + inject before task) + StaticSource trivial impl. The concrete integration point for long-term memory / retrieval (M8). Source failure aborts the run (strict).
features.evidence: pkg/agent/agent.go WithContextPolicy + Run injects sources after system/before task; StaticSource in context.go; agent_test.go covers injection order + strict-abort-on-source-error

milestones.name: Pipeline Engine
milestones.goal: Multi-stage orchestration with verification gates and checkpoint

features.name: Stage Interface
features.description: Define Stage[In, Out] with Run() and Verify() (verification gate). Define Gate types: Auto, LLMReview, HumanApproval. Stage[In,Out] is the EXPLICIT inter-agent handoff channel: one stage's typed output becomes the next stage's input (the per-agent ContextPolicy is vertical/independent; this is the horizontal passing between agents).

features.name: Pipeline FSM
features.description: Finite state machine: stage registration, conditional routing (next/retry/fail), maxRetries per stage. ~300 lines. PipelineState carries a named-key SHARED CONTEXT region (a blackboard, e.g. map[string]any or typed) — this is the inter-agent memory-SHARING mechanism (cf. ADK session.State / StateDelta, Eino AddSessionValue/GetSessionValue session keys). A stage's agent READS shared state via a ContextSource (the M4-005 seam) bound to PipelineState, and WRITES results back via the Stage output or a memory tool (M8). Deliberately keeps the Agent interface unchanged — sharing is composed from ContextSource (read) + Stage output / tool (write), not a new Agent capability.

features.name: Checkpoint Store
features.description: SQLite-backed checkpoint: serialize PipelineState via gob, save/restore on stage transitions. Pipeline survives process restarts. MUST persist the FULL conversation history (durable log), not just FSM state — so M4 compaction becomes a lossy *projection* sent to the model, while the original remains recoverable. Add the deferred ContextPolicy.OnEvict hook here (compaction writes evicted/truncated content to this store before dropping it). Separates 'what is sent' (reduced) from 'what is stored' (lossless), matching Eino/tRPC/ADK.

features.name: Interrupt / Resume
features.description: Human-in-the-loop: pipeline pauses at HumanApproval gates, persists state, resumes when approval arrives via API or CLI.

features.name: Audit Log
features.description: Event audit table in SQLite: every stage transition, gate result, error, and resume action is logged with timestamp.

milestones.name: Dev Workflow
milestones.goal: Complete development workflow: requirement → design → code → review → test
milestones.go_skills: Comprehensive application of all previous skills

features.name: Requirement Analysis Stage
features.description: Agent reads requirement description, analyzes scope, identifies affected components. Output: structured RequirementSpec.

features.name: Technical Design Stage
features.description: Agent generates technical design doc based on RequirementSpec. Output: TechDesign with approach, files to modify, risks.

features.name: Coding Stage
features.description: Agent implements code changes per TechDesign using file/shell tools. Narrow+deep ContextPolicy. Output: CodeChanges (file diffs).

features.name: Auto Review Stage
features.description: Evaluator-Optimizer pattern: review agent scores code quality, suggests improvements. If score < threshold, bounces back to Coding.

features.name: Testing Stage
features.description: Agent generates and runs tests. Validates build + lint + test pass. Output: TestReport.

features.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
features.description: Orchestrator-Worker pattern: orchestrator decomposes tasks, spawns worker agents in parallel goroutines, synthesizes results.

milestones.name: Long-term Memory & Retrieval
milestones.goal: Cross-session persistent memory + semantic retrieval for the long-running AI coding product (dev-workflow). Pluggable, CGO-free by default; vector DB when warranted.
milestones.ai_skills: Embeddings, semantic search, RAG, memory extraction (facts/episodes)
milestones.go_skills: Narrow interfaces + pluggable backends, cosine similarity, HTTP clients
milestones.notes: Reserved per product framing: dev-workflow is a long-line one-stop AI coding app, so long-term memory is a core need. Plugs into existing abstractions — ContextPolicy.Sources (auto pre-step retrieval, M4-005 seam) and Ring 2 Tool (agent-driven). No-CGO/single-binary constraint drives backends (in-memory cosine first; pgvector/external vector service as adapters). M6 dev-workflow may use a trivial ContextSource; M8 can be pulled before M6 if the product needs it earlier.

features.name: Retriever + MemoryStore Interfaces
features.description: Narrow Retriever (Retrieve(ctx, query) []Document) + MemoryStore (Add/Search/Delete, user/project scoped) interfaces + Document type. Boundary interfaces; backends concrete.

features.name: Embedder Interface + Remote Default
features.description: Embedder interface + default impl over a remote embeddings API (OpenAI-compatible). No local model → preserves no-CGO/single-binary.

features.name: Vector Store Backend
features.description: Pluggable vector store. Pure-Go in-memory cosine search first (zero-dep, CGO-free); interface allows pgvector / external vector service adapters later.

features.name: Memory Integration (ContextSource + Tool)
features.description: Expose retrieval as a ContextSource (automatic pre-step injection) AND as memory_search / memory_add tools (agent-driven). Reuses the M4-005 seam + Ring 2 Tool. ALSO provide a retrieval tool for compaction-offloaded content (Eino offload+ReadFileTool pattern): content evicted by M4 compaction (via the M5-003 OnEvict store) is embedded/indexed so the agent can pull it back on demand — turning lossy compaction into 'moved to cold storage, recoverable' rather than data loss.

features.name: Auto Memory Extraction
features.description: Distill facts/episodes from completed pipeline runs / sessions into the memory store, scoped by project. Inspired by tRPC-Agent-Go auto-memory.
